Definition: from G116; an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ:--Athenian.
BiblicalUsage: Luke says the Athenians and the strangers there spent their time in nothing else but telling or hearing some new thing, and Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill and addressed them as men of Athens. The word names the citizens of the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a city hungry for the newest thing is a city ready for the oldest news of all, that Christ is risen.
